realm.name: acex-admin
realm.description: An example of a role made of permissions, for people: every permission but the two of a worker

realm.name: acex-service
realm.description: An example of a role made of permissions, for the agents and workers

acex.name: credentials.reveal
acex.description: Allows to read the stored login of a device in the clear.

acex.name: operations.execute
acex.description: Allows to run raw commands on devices.

acex.name: operations.apply
acex.description: Allows to send a patch of configuration to devices.

acex.name: operations.inspect
acex.description: Allows to plan a patch and run the actions, which read from devices and change nothing.

acex.name: operations.runs.read
acex.description: Allows to list and read runs and their reports, which hold what the devices answered.

acex.name: operations.jobs
acex.description: Allows to list, read, queue again, cancel, delete and purge jobs.

acex.name: workflows.edit
acex.description: Allows to create, change and delete workflow definitions, which are stored commands.

acex.name: workflows.run
acex.description: Allows to start, continue, stop and delete workflow runs.

acex.name: workflows.runs.read
acex.description: Allows to read a workflow run and the artifacts its steps leave.

acex.name: workflows.runs.browse
acex.description: Allows to list workflow runs and read what the nodes answered in a step.

acex.name: workers.connect
acex.description: Allows to receive the login to the message broker.

acex.name: workers.report
acex.description: Allows to report the state and the result of a job.
